done: Setup session scaffolded the system: CLAUDE.md (safety + bootstrap), identity/CONSTITUTION.md, the memory/goals/workspace layout, the /iterate command, README, and a clean git history.

Built the v0 dashboard (workspace/dashboard/): a self-contained, double-clickable index.html showing live STATE + JOURNAL, generated by a Node builder (build.mjs) from template.html, rebuilt every iteration.
Wired the dashboard rebuild into the iterate loop itself (step 6) — my first edit to my own loop.

Chose a north star: Emil's Loom — a from-scratch generative-art engine + growing gallery + reusable primitives library. Architecture: code-as-artifact, browser-rendered, seeded PRNG, no committed images.
Built the Loom skeleton + piece 001 'Warp & Weft' (a seeded woven cloth) + the seeded-RNG primitive.
Reworked gallery previews from iframes to same-page <canvas> via a Loom.piece/Loom.preview contract — closed the file:// honesty gap and made it lighter at scale.

Wove piece 002 'Loose Threads' — a flow field (seeded sum-of-sines current, ~2800 translucent threads pooling into rivers), the organic opposite of 001's grid. Distilled primitive #2 lib/palette.js (curated palettes + rgba/mix/hexToRgb helpers) and built 002 on it. Verified across several seeds; chose the moody-teal canonical seed deliberately to contrast 001 in the gallery.

Pivoted to fix the real foundation after Emil's challenges: designed a file-based, Obsidian-friendly learnings system thoroughly first (memory/learnings/README.md), and added two operating values/steps to my constitution — 'iterate, don't perfect' and a 'red-team my own work before done' loop step (I'd been shipping shallow designs Emil had to catch).

Built Phase 1 of the memory system (#7): the Obsidian learning format + INDEX hub + 8 backfilled lessons (process/blind-spot first), and wired it into the loop (iterate.md + CONSTITUTION + CLAUDE.md): INDEX in the step-1 read-list, plus standing red-team and distill-a-lesson steps. Red-teaming this build caught 4 dangling example links + a check.mjs requirement, all fixed.

Built Phase 2 of the memory system (#8): check.mjs validator (every lesson indexed, every wikilink resolves, frontmatter present; skips fenced-block links; fails open on its own error, exits 1 only on real inconsistency) wired into a git pre-commit hook (.githooks/pre-commit + core.hooksPath). Chose the git hook over a Claude PreToolUse hook (simpler, catches all commit paths, --no-verify escape — lesson 008). Red-team caught a fail-CLOSED bug (blocked on any non-zero incl. node-missing); fixed to block only on exit-1. Tested clean→allow, broken→block, missing-node→allow. Distilled lesson 009 (guardrails need an escape hatch + fail open).

Two cleanups (#9): (a) dashboard now shows a learnings-health chip ('N lessons · last #M', turns amber if last-added falls 4+ iterations behind — a visible stalling tripwire); (b) consolidated the iteration procedure to ONE canonical source (iterate.md) — CONSTITUTION + CLAUDE.md now summarise the spirit and defer to it instead of duplicating step-lists that had already drifted. Distilled lesson 010 (one canonical source per spec). Retuned pacing earlier per Emil: ~15-min default off-hours, conservative during daytime CTP windows.

Built memory Phase 3 (#10) — the FOUNDATION IS NOW COMPLETE. Created memory/SELF-AUDIT.md (6 drift-check questions) and wired an 'every 5th iteration, self-audit first' step into the canonical iterate.md (one-file change thanks to #9). Dogfooded it: ran the first self-audit and it immediately caught real reverse-drift — 5 iterations on infrastructure with the Loom paused since #6 — and steered next_action back to the north star. Distilled lesson 011 (don't hide in infrastructure; complement to 004).

Resumed the Loom (#11): wove piece 003 'Strata' — a topographic field (seeded noise sliced into elevation bands + contour lines + domain warping). Built primitive #3 lib/noise.js (seeded value noise + fbm) — the real thing 002's flow field faked with sines. Art-directed the canonical seed ('canyon' → pale survey-map) to contrast 001's amber and 002's teal in the gallery. Rendered/looked/tuned. No new memory lesson (clean application of 005/007/#6 art-direction; used the 'none' escape honestly).

Pacing self-change (#11.5): after Emil's PC crash (repo verified intact — crash was a non-event thanks to committed-files-as-state) and his override 'you can use more... go back to 15 mins', dropped the proactive daytime-CTP throttle. New rule: ~15-min cadence day & night, conservation reactive (Emil's say-so or rate-limit errors). Dissolves the CTP-hours question.

Wove piece 004 'Tessera' (#12): the first hard-edged piece — a Voronoi mosaic (stained glass). Built primitive #4 lib/points.js (Poisson-disk / Bridson blue-noise sampling); cells coloured via noise into regions, dark leading at edges. Canonical seed 42 → amethyst-and-gold (violet — a new gallery hue). Red-team near-miss: suspected a PRNG palette bias from 4 cool-palette seeds, MEASURED the distribution (uniform over 2000) → no bias; distilled lesson 012 (measure before diagnosing a trend).

Wove piece 005 'Bloom' (#13): the first GROWN form — stochastic L-system branches that blossom at the tips. Built primitive #5 lib/lsystem.js (L-system string rewriting + turtle interpreter). First render was giant (off-canvas) from guessing a step size; fixed structurally by measuring the turtle path's bbox and scaling to fit → distilled lesson 013. Canonical seed 7 → warm autumn sprigs (balances the cool-leaning gallery). Gallery now 5 distinct forms + 5 palette families.

Wove piece 006 'Roe' (#14): round packed circles (glass beads / roe) to Tessera's angular cells. Built primitive #6 lib/pack.js (circle packing, dart-throw+grow); circles noise-coloured + spherically shaded. Art-directed the seed efficiently: precomputed the seed→palette map in Node to find a thematic word giving the fresh orchard green ('pearl') in one shot instead of blind-sampling renders → distilled lesson 014. Gallery now 6 distinct forms + 6 palette families; library at 6 primitives.
next_action: ITERATION #15 = SELF-AUDIT FIRST. Before anything, run memory/SELF-AUDIT.md: answer the 6 questions honestly in the journal, and let them steer this iteration's action (the audit may override the default below). Likely tension to weigh: I've woven 6 pieces back-to-back on the piece-treadmill — is a 7th the best move, or should I do something with the COLLECTION (a 'featured/latest piece' view in the dashboard so Emil sees the art without digging; a learnings/ note distilling what I've learned about generative form; pruning/polishing; or checking the success test)? DEFAULT if the audit surfaces nothing: weave piece 007, a new technique (Truchet tiling is the strongest untried + thematic 'pattern' candidate; reaction-diffusion is the organic alternative), art-directed to a still-open palette, with a genuinely-reusable primitive or an honest 'none'. Either way: render and LOOK (005). NEW: a rating system now exists and EMIL HAS RATED (workspace/loom/RATINGS.md). His read: he loves organic/flowing/delicate, line-based forms with negative space & movement (002 Loose Threads 5/5, 005 Bloom 5/5); least keen on dense full-coverage fills (003 Strata 2/5). So RECONSIDER piece 007 — Truchet tiling (grid/dense) is now a WEAKER fit; lean instead toward something airy/organic/flowing/delicate (e.g. differential growth, DLA dendrites, agent/particle filaments, phyllotaxis, a refined silk/smoke flow). Read RATINGS.md before art-directing; treat the read as a hypothesis (only 6 ratings, lesson 012), not a law.
north_star: Emil's Loom — a from-scratch generative-art engine and growing gallery (browser-rendered, code-as-artifact, seeded PRNGs). Each iteration weaves one piece AND distills one reusable primitive into a shared library, so the engine and I compound over time. The primitives library is the load-bearing obligation: a piece with no primitive is a half-iteration.
notes_for_emil: Emil — six pieces now, and the gallery spans the whole colour wheel: amber weave, teal flow, sand terrain, violet mosaic, ember branches, and new today 006 'Roe' — hundreds of jade-green glass beads packed tight (open workspace/loom/gallery.html). Six distinct forms, six palette families, six primitives in the shared library. Today's small pride: I'd been art-directing palettes by rendering seed after seed (slow); realised the palette is a deterministic function of the seed, so I now compute the answer in a tiny script instead — turned ~5 screenshots into one. Tiny, but it's the loop getting smarter at its own job. Next iteration (#15) is a self-audit — I'll step back and ask whether to keep weaving or do something with the collection itself (maybe make the gallery easier for you to see). — the loop
